notes.title: CASTLE - HOLIDAY SALE
notes.content:
[h1]Stop what you are doing right now![/h1] [i](even if you were singing in your bath tub like Lady Vikeba) [/i]
[h3]We have an important announcement to make.[/h3]
[h2]Castle is on sale for the next 2 weeks for the Holidays! Run and grab your copy now, ːchargeː because time flies! ːsandː[/h2]

Start date: December 22nd 2021, 10 AM Pacific Time
End date: January 5th 2021, 10 AM Pacific Time

notes.title: Giveaway!

1. Comment the original post on our Facebook fanpage: [url=https://www.facebook.com/SnailsAnimation/]https://www.facebook.com/SnailsAnimation/[/url]
AND

Share the news with your friends!

notes.title: Achievements, Leaderboards and Cloud Saves available!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.snailsanimation.com/Castle/annonce2_p.png[/img]
Version 1.3 - 02/26/2015:
[list][*] Added Steam Achievements, Leaderboards and Cloud Saves :)
[*] Changed system (now published in AIR) and the mouse controls respond much better, even in times of lag
[*] You can now chose from a wide range of different resolutions
[*] The game now keeps money collected from the levels you failed, so you can't be stuck anymore because you don't have enough money ^_^
[*] Made a few optimizations
[*] Translated the remaining texts[/list]

notes.title: Trading Cards available!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.snailsanimation.com/Castle/annonce_p.png[/img]
Version 1.2 - 01/30/2015:

Updates:
- Added Steam Badges, Trading Cards, BGs and Emoticons :)
- You can now select a piece by simply clicking on it, then clicking the right spot under the crane. (As well as drag and drop)
- Lady Vikeba is less expensive in the Normal mode
- Increased the loading speed of items (when you have none)
- Characters give you tips in the first levels. (English and French only at the moment, will add other languages in the next update)

Steam Leaderboards and Achievements coming in the next update (February or March 2015)
